meta.name: release
meta.description: Cut a booping plugin release — verify the version bump against the last published tag, draft public-voiced release notes, merge the release branch into master, tag, and publish the GitHub release. Use when cutting a vX.Y.Z release of this repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本发布全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化GitHub仓库的版本发布流程。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate version releases for a GitHub repository.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你完成一个 booping 插件的版本发布流程：验证版本号、起草发布说明、合并分支、打标签并发布到 GitHub。
howto.when: 当你需要发布 booping 插件的新版本（如 v1.2.3），并且当前在 release/X.Y.Z 分支上时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布 booping 插件 v1.2.3。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行发布流程。

say.text: 检查当前分支是否准备好发布。
say.note: Claude 会运行预检步骤并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you cut a release of the booping plugin: verify the version bump, draft release notes, merge the release branch to master, tag, and publish the GitHub release.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to release a new version of the booping plugin (e.g., v1.2.3) and you are on a release/X.Y.Z branch.

say_en.text: Cut a release for booping plugin v1.2.3.
say_en.note: Claude will start the release process.

say_en.text: Check if the current branch is ready for release.
say_en.note: Claude will run preflight checks and report.
